start.description: Start of the data point window as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

end.description: End of the data point window as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

volume.description: Number of delivered messages the row covers.

cost.description: Cost of the row in the WABA's billing currency. Omitted when COST is not requested or not available.

phone_number.description: Business phone number, present when PHONE is a requested dimension.

country.description: Two-letter country code, present when COUNTRY is a requested dimension.

pricing_category.description: Pricing category, present when PRICING_CATEGORY is a requested dimension.

pricing_type.description: Pricing type, present when PRICING_TYPE is a requested dimension.

tier.description: Volume tier, present when TIER is a requested dimension.

items.description: Message volume and cost for one window and dimension combination.

data_points.description: One entry per window and dimension combination.
